How to Figure Tax Using the 2025 California Tax Rate Schedules
Example: Chris and Pat Smith are filing a joint tax return using Form 540. Their taxable income on Form 540, line 19 is $125,000.
Step 1:    Using Schedule Y, they find the taxable income range that includes their taxable income of $125,000.


                                                                                                                                                                      Example                      Your Income
Step 2:    They subtract the amount at the beginning of their range from                                                                                             $ 125,000                     $
           their taxable income                                                                                                                                      – 115,084                     –
                                                                                                                                                                     $ 9,916                       $

Step 3:    They multiply the result from Step 2 by the percentage for                                                                                                $ 9,916                       $
           their range.                                                                                                                                              x    .08                      x
                                                                                                                                                                     $ 793.28                      $

Step 4:    They round the amount from Step 3 to two decimals (if                                                                                                     $3,974.82                     $
           necessary) and add it to the tax amount for their income                                                                                                  + 793.28                      +
           range. After rounding the result, they will enter $4,768 on                                                                                               $4,768.10                     $
           Form 540, line 31.
